entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, this VeloBand Pulse you sold me is a complete piece of junk. It's not working and I want my money back. Now.

I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand Pulse. I can definitely look into this for you. To best help, could you clarify the problem for me? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

A technical fault? The thing is completely broken! It was working for a week and now it won't sync with the app at all. It just sits there. It's a defective product and I'm not interested in wasting any more time on it. I want a refund.
Okay, I understand your frustration. It's definitely not the experience we want for our customers when a device won't sync properly. Let me pull up your order information.

I see you received the VeloBand Pulse 17 days ago. For a defective item outside the 10-day full refund window, our standard procedure is to get you immediately to our technical support team. They're equipped to troubleshoot the syncing issue, and if they determine it's a hardware fault, they can process a warranty replacement right away.

Ten days? Are you kidding me? I don't want a replacement, I want my money back! This is unacceptable service. I want to speak to your manager right now. I'm about to post a review about this on every fitness blog I can find.

I certainly understand your position, and I hear your frustration. A manager would follow the exact same warranty process for a technical fault. My main goal right now is to solve this for you as quickly as possible, and the technical team is the most direct path. They can run diagnostics that I can't and are authorized to ship a replacement if it's confirmed to be defective. I can transfer you right now.
Fine! Transfer me. But you better believe if they can't fix this broken thing in five minutes, I'm calling back and I will not be so calm.

I appreciate that. I will add detailed notes to your file for the tech specialist so you won't have to repeat yourself. They are the experts who will get this resolved. Please hold one moment while I connect you.
